one_liner: Managed API for YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists

evidence.claim: API key sent as Bearer token in Authorization header
Self-serve signup issues an API key immediately with free credits
evidence.quote: Your agent creates a TranscriptAPI account and gets an API key on first use — no manual setup needed. You get 100 free credits to start.

evidence.claim: REST API surface covers transcripts plus several YouTube data endpoints
evidence.quote: transcripts, YouTube search, channel listing, channel search, playlist extraction, channel resolve, and latest uploads

evidence.claim: Vendor ships/documents its own MCP server for agent clients
evidence.quote: native YouTube MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other agent clients

evidence.claim: Free tier then low-cost paid plans; no sales gate
evidence.quote: 100 free credits, then plans starting at $5 per month

notes: Credit-based pricing (1 credit per transcript/search call). Vendor docs include MCP integration guides for ChatGPT and Claude (transcriptapi.com/docs/mcp). GitHub repo ZeroPointRepo/youtube-mcp describes a 'TranscriptAPI MCP' toolkit but the org's vendor affiliation is unverified; official MCP status rests on the vendor's own docs. Homepage claims 49ms median latency and 15M+ transcripts/month.
